program: SNAP (formerly Food Stamps — the old name persists in Georgia usage)
agency: Georgia Division of Family and Children Services (DFCS), under the Department of Human Services (DHS)
admin_note: State-administered: 'The Department of Human Services (DHS), Division of Family and Children Services through the local County Department of Family and Children Services (DFCS) is responsible for administering the SNAP program in Georgia' (SNAP Manual §3000) — county DFCS offices are the state's field arm, not independent county agencies. Policy lives in the DFCS SNAP Policy Manual on PAMMS (pamms.dhs.ga.gov — the old ODIS host redirects there), amended by numbered Manual Transmittals (MT-87 current at build). Georgia Gateway is both the application portal and the eligibility system of record.
system: Georgia Gateway (integrated eligibility; also runs the ABAWD Time Clock); EBT rides the EPPIC platform via ConnectEBT

update_channels.name: DFCS SNAP Policy Manual (PAMMS) + MT transmittals
